resources.string: Energy bank from %1$s to %2$s: now %3$s, lowest %4$s. Stretches without a reading are left empty.
There is no energy curve for this day.
The energy bank is a model, not a measurement. It starts at your morning recovery score and moves minute by minute from when you woke.
It drains a little every awake minute, more when your heart rate is in a training zone, and more again while stress is high. It charges slowly in calm, still minutes and quickly during a nap.
The size of each step is Apex\'s own choice and is not validated. Read the shape as a hint about your day, not a number to chase.
A minute without a heart rate adds no activity drain, and Apex does not fill it in.
